title: Backend and automated services
summary: Use hosted data or machine-payment interfaces only after the onchain flow is understood; both surfaces are still evolving.

links.description: REST and RPC entry point for blocks, balances, tokens, transfers, transactions, webhooks, sponsorship, routes, and exchange data.
Custom read-only SQL over hot PostgreSQL and archival ClickHouse data. Prefer stable REST endpoints for common reads and pin queried schemas.
HTTP 402 payment challenges for API and agent services, with one-time charges and session-style payment flows. Advanced and still fast-moving.
